papers.title: Conformable Fractional Gradient Descent: A Local Optimizer for Neural Network Training
papers.abstract: This paper proposes Conformable Fractional Gradient Descent (CFGD) for neural network training. CFGD is local and avoids the history-dependent cost of Caputo and Riemann-Liouville methods. It rescales the current gradient using a conformable factor. We study constant-order CFGD and a variable-order version with αk↑1 for stability. We test the methods on oscillatory function approximation using a one-hidden-layer tanh network. CFGD improves accuracy over standard gradient descent and a Caputo-based baseline. Its per-iteration cost is comparable to gradient descent. The variable-order scheme further improves stability and reduces error.
